text: At entry 2130, updateDialogData caches data before the Calendar dialog connects. connectedCallback calls it with init=true so a cached title is rendered even when the same object/title is supplied again. Later connected calls avoid unchanged-title writes. The added test covers empty, populated and cleared title text, not this preconnection path. Review also required back-button-before-title order in production, test and Storybook templates; all three changed accordingly. Two-line, overflow and tooltip work was deferred. Fixed0b93 uses the later event-loading API, so the historical setter is not a current interface recommendation. Static source/context inspection only; no UI test ran.
title: The initial Calendar title setter forced cached data into the connected template
